meta.title: Evnelo: open-source event ticketing, 0.99% fees
meta.description: Sell tickets and register attendees for 0.99% on paid tickets and nothing on free events. Open source, payouts to your own Stripe, QR check-in, waitlists.

pricing.title: Lower fees than any other platform.
pricing.body: Most platforms take 3 to 5 percent plus a fee on every ticket. Evnelo takes 0.99% on paid tickets and nothing on free ones. You connect your own Stripe account, so ticket money goes straight to you and never sits with us; Stripe’s processing fee applies at Stripe’s rate, and you can pass fees to buyers or absorb them.

free.title: Free events
free.note: No platform fee, no per-ticket fee, unlimited attendees.

paid.title: Paid events
paid.note: On the ticket price, charged through your connected Stripe account. A $25 ticket costs you 25 cents, plus Stripe.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.note: Open source. One container, your MySQL, your own Stripe keys. No platform fee, ever.

flow.title: Everything between “I want to go” and “I’m here”.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: An event page with your cover, schedule, venue and hosts. Public, unlisted, or private by invitation.

register.text: Ticket tiers, your own questions, guests with their own tickets, discount codes, a waitlist when you sell out.

pay.title: Pay and receive
pay.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Pix. Tickets with a QR code, wallet passes, calendar files, confirmation by email and SMS.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.text: A scanner that runs in any phone browser, keeps working without signal, and shows the room filling up live.

openSource.title: Your events. Your data. Your stack.
openSource.body: Evnelo is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Host it yourself with one container and one MySQL database, plug in your own Stripe, Resend and Vonage keys, and keep every attendee record on your own infrastructure. Same product, no platform fee.

pricingPage.title: 0.99% on paid tickets. Nothing on free ones.
pricingPage.body: One price for every feature. No monthly plan, no fixed fee per ticket, no setup fee. Ticket money goes to your own Stripe account, and Stripe charges its processing fee there at its usual rate.

evnelo.title: Evnelo takes 0.99%
evnelo.text: As part of the same charge, on paid tickets only.

payout.title: Stripe pays you out

monthly.a: No. The hosted service has no subscription. You pay 0.99% when you sell a paid ticket and nothing otherwise.

stripe.a: You do, on your own Stripe account, at the rate Stripe gives you. Evnelo adds nothing to it.

passOn.q: Can buyers pay the 0.99% instead of me?
passOn.a: Yes. Turn on the service fee for an event and checkout shows it as its own line. The buyer pays it and you receive the full ticket price.

free.a: Yes, at any size. Email confirmations and reminders are included. Text messages on a free event cost a one-time $5 for that event; on paid events they are included.

refunds.q: What happens to the fee on a refund?
refunds.a: The 0.99% is not returned when you refund an order, and Stripe keeps its processing fee too. If the buyer paid the service fee, it goes back to them with the order.

currencies.q: Which currencies can I sell in?
currencies.a: Any currency your Stripe account accepts. The fee is 0.99% of the ticket price in that currency.

selfHost.a: Nothing to Evnelo. You pay for your own server, database and email and SMS providers. The code is on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license.

payments.title: How payments work
payments.body: You connect your own Stripe account. Stripe handles the Pix and card payments and pays you out, charging its processing fee on your account at the rate it gives you. Evnelo takes 0.99% of paid tickets as part of the same charge.

passOn.q: Can the buyer pay the fee?
passOn.a: Yes. Turn on the service fee for an event and checkout shows it as its own line, so you receive the full ticket price.

pix.q: When does Pix show up at checkout?
pix.a: When Pix is turned on in your Stripe account and the tickets are priced in reais.
